title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season' Second Cour Announced for Fall 2026
content: • The 12th and final episode of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season ( Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 ) ended with the announcement of a second cour on Sunday.
